[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217843.png[/img]
This is a story-driven mod, this is NOT a normal dialogue and events expansion. The story is paced by game progression through rebuilding the Community Center, NOT by heart level. Read the Mod Mechanics section below for more details.

If you love snarky banter and a lot of shenanigans, you'll have fun with this dialogue! And it continues through at least two years of marriage. All daily dialogue is unique for the first game year [b]and[/b] the first year of marriage, with a large pool of randomized dialogue after that. Marriage dialogue also acknowledges your kids if you have any.

Events include a lot of choices and some will determine things like whether Sebastian quits smoking or not. There are also magic components, especially during dating. An event after marriage determines if you want kids or not, if the choice is made to not have children, then that feature is disabled in Sebastian's character profile so you don't have to deal with the baby question later.

Marriage dates are included (reworked versions of Immersive Sebastian dates), I might add more in the future.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768198861.png[/img]
[b][size=4]Gameplay Requirements[/size][/b]
[b]Smirking Frog PSA:[/b] notice the above word "requirements", these items are NOT suggestions.
* [i]REQUIRES[/i] a new save. This is not a suggestion. This mod will not work correctly on an existing save. The end.
* [i]REQUIRES[/i] the Community Center route, switching to Joja will break the story and events won't trigger correctly. Seriously.
Note: Using cheats to complete the CC rooms faster than the end of year 1 will result in missed story content, but will not break the mod. Cheat at your own risk.

[b][size=4]Mod Mechanics[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Includes a journal guidebook thanks to the Parchment framework. Details below.[/*]
[*]The Smirking Frog Event Commission will send you letters when events are available. Count on them, they are VERY reliable. The Smirking Frogs also send you PSA messages to give you tips and guidance.[/*]
[*]Farmer has a voice, this is necessary to tell the story. Farmer does have dialogue choices, but all drive the same storyline.[/*]
[*]Sebastian has unique dialogue every day of the first year, a major part of the story is told through daily dialogue.[/*]
[*]Sebastian will reject the bouquet before the community center is finished and a specific event seen. Feel free to offer one for a snarky response.[/*]
[*]Sebastian gets a job, moves out of the basement, and goes to work. His schedule and home location reflect this. He continues to work after marriage three days a week. Go bother him at work, you know you want to![/*]
[*]Adds Marlon from SVE as a full, friendable character if you don't have SVE installed. (no SVE events for Marlon are included)[/*]
[*]Pace yourself - to get the most out of the story, complete the CC as normal at the end of year 1 or mid year 2. Want to really get into the content and force yourself to slow down? Try a challenging bundle mod![/*]
[*]Poly Players - this mod is technically poly-compatible until marriage, but after that this mod will break. To make that a part of the story, Sebastian will not date the player if they are dating or married to someone else since he is not polyamorous in this mod. If farmer asks Sebastian out while already dating/married, or cheats while married to him, a warning will pop up describing what will happen and how to avoid it. No surprises.[/*]
[*]Dating other characters during the first year - farmer can date others before dating Sebastian, however, watch your timing! Break up with other people immediately after finishing the Community Center. If you do not, Sebastian will not confess to farmer. NOTE: Currently, you cannot get the Cold Shoulder event with this mod.[/*]
[*]Full marriage content included:
Daily good morning conversation, unique every day of the first year of marriage
Events for the first two children, this will be expanded when I finish the Sebastian Kids mod for Have More Kids[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Player's Journal[/size][/b]
After learning the Junimo language, Magnus sends farmer an old apprentice's journal he found. This is your guide through the mod events and includes hidden achievements for fun.
Currently includes event tips and sprites plus a bonus sticker collection. More will be added with updates!
[b]Check the journal Help page for an in-game guide.[/b]

[b][size=3]Was AI used in the creation of this mod?[/size][/b]
[i]SIGH[/i]... NO. I wrote every single word and line of code with my evil tiefling-loving hands.

[b][size=3]Why is this mod marked Beta?[/size][/b]
I tested it as much as my sanity allowed, but this mod uses a lot of BETAS triggers and I can't test every single possible scenario. AKA I'm paranoid. Please comment if you run into any issues, I actively maintain my mods.

[b][size=3]Does farmer's dialogue have female/male variants?[/size][/b]
Farmer is written to work with either female or male base. Their dialogue is neutral. My own personality is neither strongly feminine nor masculine, so I'm usually able to easily pull this off. That said, if you see a line that you feel is overly gender-leaning, you can comment with the exact line text. I will read your comment. That's all I promise.

[b][size=3]Is this polyamory compatible?[/size][/b]
Answered above, but since I know you will ask again, the answer is partially.
[b]How? What does that mean?[/b]
Start your required new save and play through this story as far as you want. When you're ready to sow your wild oats, uninstall this mod. If you do not and you're married to Seb, the Smirking Frog Legal Team will arrive and serve you divorce papers signed by Sebastian. If you quit your game without saving and uninstall this mod, your relationship with him will not change.
[b]But WHYYYYYYYY? You ask. And I will tell you.[/b]
* Technical answer: Polyamory changes the core game code and limits my ability to customize marriage content. That is why. I will not entirely change my mod to accommodate another mod.
* Creative answer: I do not write for poly. I write very immersive storylines for a single character. AKA, I do not want to and I do not get paid for this.

[b][size=3]Will you make your mod compatible with [i](random mod name) [/i]mod?[/size][/b]
Small compatibility tweaks? I will investigate and let you know. Will I change entire immersive content sections? NO. I am crazy obsessed, but I am not insane.

[b][size=3]I gave Sebastian a bouquet at 8 hearts and he said no![/size][/b]
Did he confess to you in an event? No? Then wait for the event. This story requires you to play through the events. You will be informed in the game when things unlock, either in the journal or mail from the Smirking Frogs.

[b][size=3]Where is the event list?? OMG... I can't live without an event list![/size][/b]
Events are in the journal. They show up there when they are unlocked. You will also get a letter from the Smirking Frog just in case you don't want to use the journal. Don't worry, you will be fine!
